QuestInfo.name: The Seal Stones and the Hero
QuestInfo.0: You fill Luminous in on the situation, but aren't sure what he can tell you about Seal Stones. Speak to him again.
QuestInfo.1: Speak to Luminous again to see what he knows about Seal Stones. \r\n#rIf you fail to complete the quest, forfeit it and start again from Polite Talk with Grendel the Really Old.#k
QuestInfo.2: You fill Luminous in on the situation, and he explains that the Seal Stones were created to seal the Black Mage. He's not sure if they have the power to restore continents...

yes.0: I know you can restore Maple Island, using the power within you.

no.0: What else is there to do around here? I have to build a new Sentrobo anyway. I'll make him stronger this time.
